newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh's cabinet has endorsed a proposal for introducing private airplane and helicopter services on domestic routes.
The government would form a committee headed by the Prime Minister to formulate a national water management policy, Water Resources Minister Abdur Razzak said.
Country's 39 lakh electricity consumers will have to pay an additional 10 percent on bills from Tuesday (Oct 1) following a raise in power tariff.
Most of the ministers submitted statement of their wealth to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina during a cabinet meeting on Monday.
The government has formed a national committee to hammer out a political solution to the staggering insurgency problem in the Chittagong hill districts.

Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has set the government an October 15 deadline to stop what it said ruling party's repression on opposition or face "tougher" agitation. BNP Secretary-General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan claimed over 100 of his party's leaders and workers had been killed in hundred days of Awami League rule.
Foreign investors have sought government intervention to ease bureaucrtic tangles and remove "discrminatory" coporate tax system.
